notes.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof 200K Downloads Q&A Revealed!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the development team of Five Hearts Under One Roof.

Thanks to your incredible support, our game has officially surpassed 200,000 downloads!
We truly appreciate all the love you’ve shown us.

To celebrate this milestone, we’re excited to share the answers to the Q&A you submitted on Discord!
Hear from Mal-sook and the dev team as they answer your most curious questions.

We’ll continue to bring you more exciting updates and fun content,
so please keep showing us your love and support!

Thank you! 💖

=====================================================

[b]1. What's your favourite scene with your character?[/b]

Mal-sook)
The confession scene is my favorite.
It really felt like the moment things shifted between me and Yuman, from friend to something deeper.

[b]2. If you were Yuman, which character (beside yourself) would you want to date?[/b]

Mal-sook)
I think I'd want to try dating Seung-yi.
She's someone I'd feel the need to protect.

[b]3. Did you all know each other before?[/b]
Mal-sook)
Yes! We had all crossed paths before through YouTube appearances, 
so we were familiar with one another.
That made the set atmosphere really fun, we laughed a lot during the filming.

I especially remember Min-jung always cracking up and making NG cuts.
There was one scene where we were all gathered together in the house, and Min-jung couldn't stop laughing. We all ended up laughing with her for like 30 minutes.

[b]4. Is Gran as tough in real life as she is in the game? Or does she have softer side?[/b]

Mal-sook)
Gran's actually super soft and girly in real life.
She’s also the kind of person who looks out for everyone and takes care of the people around her."

[b]5. Mal-sook! Please marry me!!! ^^a[/b]

Mal-sook)
(laughs) Maybe if you dream about it three times—it could come true then!"

[b]6. What's your most memorable moment from filming?[/b]

Mal-sook)
Filming at the Han River and the beach was tough because it was insanely windy.
Our hair was flying everywhere—it was a struggle for everyone.

[b](How did you manage?)[/b]

Mal-sook)
We fought back with hairspray! (laughs)
We just waited for the wind to die down and kept filming in short bursts.

[b]7. Was filming a happy experience?[/b]

Mal-sook)
I mean... is work ever truly happy?
It was super tough and exhausting—but honestly, it was also a lot of fun.

[b]8. You helped plan the project, right?[/b]
[b]Can you share some behind-the-scenes stories?[/b]
[b]Why did you choose a boarding house as the setting?[/b]
[b]What's the story behind the name "Yuman"?[/b]
[b]Who came up with the sausage bro route or ending?"[/b]

Malsook)
Why a boarding house?

I thought it would be the perfect setting to bring all the characters together.

There’s something kind of intimate—and yes, a little sexy—about sharing a living space.
As for the name "Yuman," we’d already been using it on the Milk Film YouTube channel. ("Milk" is “우유(re: u-yu)” in Korean.)

The sausage route idea came up during a team brainstorming session.
I really believe a story needs some good comedy, so we were tossing around fun concepts, and this one just stuck. Everyone liked it, so we went with it!

[b]9. About Five Hearts Under One Roof 2:[/b]

Hi everyone! This is the Five Hears Under One Roof team.
We've seen so many questions about Five Hearts Under One Roof 2, so here’s a quick update.

We’re aiming for a release in the second half of this year.
We’d love to launch with full multilingual support, but if that’s not possible, we’ll roll it out gradually.

Sausage-type, Eunbi, and Seung-yi won’t be appearing in Season 2.
That said, we’re actively discussing future projects for both Eunbi and Seung-yi, so please keep an eye out!

We truly love all of the Five Hearts Under One Roof cast, and we're so grateful for your continued support.

[b]10. Questions from Malsook to all of you![/b]

Is there a character you’d like to see in the future?
What kind of looks or personality do you want?

Are there any locations or types of scenes you'd like to see in a dating sim?
I’d love to show you more of Korea—its landmarks, culture, and food!

============================================================

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: 현재 논란이 일고 있는 내용에 대한 입장문
notes.notes:
안녕하세요 [하.전.미] 디렉터이자 촬영을 직접 담당했던 노디 감독입니다.

아래 해명에 앞서 먼저 이번 논란을 일으켜 죄송하다는 말씀 먼저 드리며
저는 남성이고 페미니스트나 특정 사상을 전혀 지지하지 않음을 밝힙니다.

문제가 된 장면은 ‘하숙집’ 전단지를 붙이러 가는 장면으로,
1인칭 시점에서 해당 전단지의 내용과 붙이러 가는 상황을 보여줘야 했습니다.

하지만 당일 야외 촬영 당시 바람이 부는 상황이었고,
종이가 계속해서 접혀 종이의 내용이 제대로 촬영 되지 않아
접히는 종이 부분을 검지 손가락으로 받치고 찍는 방식으로 촬영을 진행했습니다.

(정확한 설명을 위해 해당 상황을 재현한 영상을 추가 공유드립니다. 신속한 재현을 위해 집에서 촬영한 점 양해 부탁드리겠습니다.)

본 촬영은 그 어떤 의도도 하지 않은 저의 개인적인 상황대처 방법이었으며,
다른 제작진이나 출연진과 전혀 논의하지 않은 부분이었습니다.
(다시 한번 저는 절대 페미니스트가 아니며, 그 사상을 전혀 지지하지 않음을 밝힙니다.)

또한 해당 부분이 문제가 될 수 있었음에도,
편집과 검수 과정 등을 통해 해당 장면을 걸러내지 못한 점 정말 고개 숙여 사과드립니다.

현재 해당 부분은 문제를 발견한 뒤 게임사와 논의하여 수정하고 있습니다.
금일 중으로 즉시 해당 내용 덜어내어 업데이트 할 예정이며,
추후 재촬영 역시 진행하여 영상 전면 교체하도록 하겠습니다.

플레이에 불편함이 없도록 빠르게 시정하겠으며,
다시 한번 죄송하다는 말씀드립니다.

긴 글 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.
